//: Type checking only -- esbuild does the emitting and does not typecheck,
so `npm run typecheck` in tools/web is the half it cannot do.
The two vendored typings are not the same shape and cannot be reached the
same way.  xterm.d.ts declares its module AMBIENTLY, so including the file
is enough and a paths entry onto it fails with `not a module`.
addon-fit.d.ts imports @xterm/xterm at the top, which makes the file a
module and its `declare module` an AUGMENTATION rather than a definition,
so that one has to be reached by paths.  tools/web/build.mjs gives esbuild
both names as aliases onto the .mjs beside them.
